name: Menu field colors
notes: Colors of the menu map's ground (ts_menu_field): 1-6 are the meadow's own (pal_ground_normal's outline, white, tip highlight, grass, tufts and shade, at the same numbers, so the field's grass is the Normal world's), 7-10 the garden bed's soil, darkest to lightest: exactly pal_garden's soil browns, so the plants' little dug holes (drawn by the plot sprites) match the bed under them pixel for pixel.
